purpose: Teach: ズーム/ベンツ/ルネッサンス/洋画/マンチェスター/ジャンボ/アドリブ/コナン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カメラのズーム操作で悩んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there was a customer earlier who was struggling with camera zoom settings.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Sharing a small detail like noticing something together. Gentle pacing, intimate—the kind of thing you'd mention while making tea.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ベンツに乗ってお越しになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer who came in driving a Mercedes, actually.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation, adding a layer. Slight lift of intrigue on the detail. Still intimate, building the picture together. Conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ルネッサンス絵画にお詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And apparently they really know their Renaissance paintings.
lines.style: Wondering tone, slight admiration underneath. Soft attack on the opening. The cadence of someone impressed but not performing the impression. Trailing slightly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、洋画好きでよく映画館に行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They go to the cinema a lot—prefers Western films, from what they said.
lines.style: Continuing the thread naturally, like you're piecing someone together in conversation. Warm, no judgment. Easy pacing, building detail on detail.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マンチェスターに留学経験がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Studied abroad in Manchester, they mentioned.
lines.style: Soft, factual mention. The tenderness of noticing what someone has lived through. Brief pause before the name—respect for the detail. Quiet wonder.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジャンボサイズのコーヒーをお頼みになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they ordered a jumbo-size coffee, which—honestly, says something, doesn't it?
lines.style: Light humor here, a small smile in the voice. Wry affection at an oddly specific detail. The joke is gentle, not at the customer's expense. Slight comedic timing on the dash.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アドリブの効くピアニストでいらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Turns out they're a pianist who can improvise.
lines.style: Admiration breaking through the observational tone. Slight lift on 'improvise'—genuine respect for a skill. Warm, not performing. Natural rhythm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、コナンの新刊を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And when I saw them, they were reading the new Detective Conan book.
lines.style: Finishing the portrait gently. Small smile in the voice. Warm observation, the detail that makes someone human and real. Slight trailing-off, like the picture is complete now.
